shared_elements: upright rectangular stone slab/monolith carved in relief
horizontal band of repeated motifs running across the surface
animal or creature forms rendered in profile
raised, rounded relief forms standing out from a flat ground
justification: Both are tall rectangular stone slabs whose surfaces are divided into horizontal registers, with a band of small repeated units crossing the field and profile creature forms carved in raised relief. Beyond that generic scheme they diverge sharply: A is sparse, flat, low relief with isolated widely spaced animals on empty ground, while B is a dense, deeply undercut, all-over composition dominated by a single frontal costumed figure framed by blocky glyph-like panels.
